nodes.label: SVG icon sprite sheet defining six reusable <symbol> icons for social/community and documentation links: 'bluesky-icon' (Bluesky butterfly logo), 'discord-icon' (Discord game controller/face logo), 'documentation-icon' (open book with chat bubbles, purple stroke #aa3bff), 'github-icon' (GitHub Octocat/cat silhouette logo), 'social-icon' (a person with a connection/network badge, purple stroke #aa3bff), and 'x-icon' (X/Twitter logo). Likely used in a site footer or community/links section.
